Security policy

Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue. Report the vulnerability privately through GitHub's vulnerability reporting (the repository's Security tab, then Report a vulnerability), and include:

  • the problem and what an attacker could achieve with it;
  • steps to reproduce it, together with the Vodka and macOS versions used;
  • a proposed fix, if one is available.

A reply will follow within a few days. Vodka is a small volunteer project, so the time to a fix depends on available capacity, although a serious issue takes precedence over other work. State how you wish to be named if you would like credit in the advisory.

Scope

Only the most recent version of Vodka receives fixes. In scope:

  • the Vodka application, VodkaKit, the VodkaCmd tool and the Quick Look extension;
  • how Vodka downloads, verifies and installs its engine and Apple's Game Porting Toolkit;
  • the build and install scripts in this repository.

Out of scope; report these upstream:

  • bugs in Wine itself (WineHQ), DXVK, DXMT, MoltenVK or D3DMetal;
  • Windows programs run inside Vodka. Wine is not a sandbox: a Windows program can read and write anything the Mac account can, so run only trusted software.

Vodka does not author the Wine engine. It downloads a build and installs it. When a serious vulnerability is fixed upstream, the response is to rebuild the engine on the fixed version and release it.

Data

Vodka collects no usage data and contains no analytics. It accesses the network only to download its engine and Steam's installer, and to check for updates.

Vodka is licensed under GPL-3.0.
